Fisheries
Plain
Provide 1 to 2 % feed for feeding according to fish weight, Use lime @ 200 Kg/ha/month,
Maintain minimum 1.5 meter level of water, disinfect the net and other equipments before and
after use, harvesting and marketing of old fish stock,
chunks.publisher: Directorate of Extension Education, GBPUAT Pantnagar

chunks.chunk_text:
Pond preparation: Use cow dung/compost @ 10 q/ha and filled the pond with water upto one
meter followed by application of lime @ 200 kg/ha.
After 15-20 days when pond water become green in color, stock fish seed of Rohu, Katla,
mrigal, silver carp, common carp and grass carp species (4-6 cm) @ 6000-8000/ha .
Hill
Provide 1 to 2 % feed for feeding according to fish weight, Use lime @ 2 Kg/100 sq
meter/month, Maintain minimum 1.0 meter level of water, disinfect the net and other equipments
before and after use, harvesting and marketing of old fish stock,
Pond preparation: Use cow dung/compost @ 50 kg/100 sq meter and filled the pond with water
up-to one meter followed by application of lime @ 2 kg/100 sq meter.
After 15-20 days when pond water become green in color, stock fish seed of silver carp,
common carp and grass carp species (4-6 cm) @ 250-300/100 sq meter .
